turns.previous_reply:
I understand plain English. Mostly. Things you can ask me:
      status               camp overview
      who is here          your survivors and where they are
      who is hurt          medical report
      who is best at first aid   recorded skills at camp
      how is <name>        one survivor, in detail
      how many <item>      count it in camp storage
      is that enough for 250   compare the last item with a quantity
      how much food        food, calories and days left
      how do I purify water / treat a wound   game survival reference
      what is everyone doing   jobs and work orders
      any problems         blocked or stuck jobs
      shortages / alarms   stock targets and camp alerts
      refuel generator / refuel <vehicle name>
      send medic to <name> / retry job <job ID>
      Requests need your Y/N confirmation before anything happens.
      You can ask two questions together. Send each action request separately.
      power / weather / time
      how am I / am I infected   your condition; requires a recovered medical index
      my kills / days survived / my skills   your own file, available anywhere
      when is the helicopter / when will the water stop   recovered county calendar
      weather tomorrow / next storm   forecast through the next six days
      when is dawn / when does it get dark   the seasonal almanac
      any zombies          movement near this building
      expedition           news from the away team
      deliveries           returned cargo awaiting storage
      advice               what I would do, if I had hands
      how do I <task>      operating help for camp jobs, travel and this station
      tell me more / check again   follow the topic or refresh its readings
      what were we talking about / back to <subject>
      forget that conversation   clear the recent thread; keep saved notes
      remember <note>      add a short note to the shared EMMA notebook
      forget everything    choose which shared notes to erase
      fragments            recovered computers and memory progress
      factory reset        erase this computer's old files and branding; shared notes remain
      open radio / scan for broadcasts   mounted walkie-talkie radio desk
      save this channel as <name> / what did we hear
      clear / exit
    Or just talk to me. I am told it helps. I am told a lot of things.
